name: Reference Outstanding
query:
select
    sales.name as `Invoice No:Data:150`,
    sales.posting_date as `Date:Date:100`,
    sales.customer as `Customer:Link/Customer:150`,
    sales.customer_name as `Customer Name:Data:200`,
    group_concat(sales.referred_by) as `Referred By:Data:150`,
    sum(sales.grand_total) as `Total Customer Billing:Float:125`,
    (select ifnull(sum(debit),0)-ifnull(sum(credit),0)
      from `tabGL Entry`
        where
          party=sales.customer
            and party_type='Customer') as `Current Customer Balance:Float:125`
from `tabSales Invoice` as sales 
where
    sales.docstatus= 1
    and sales.delayed_payment = 1
group by sales.customer
having abs(`Current Customer Balance:Float:125`) not between 0 and 300
order by `Current Customer Balance:Float:125` desc, sales.customer_name
